boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented NYU spaces for studying, connecting, making art, and taking part in campus life around Washington Square.

cards.title: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library
cards.subtitle: 70 Washington Square South
cards.notes: Use the floor maps to choose a study area or service point, then settle in during library open hours with your NYU ID.
cards.short_summary: NYU’s main library combines stacks seating, study rooms, computers, and research help.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU identifies Bobst as its largest library and describes it as a major campus study space; its floor maps identify study areas and service points.
cards.access_notes: Library buildings are open to current NYU students, faculty, and staff; consult the Libraries directory for current building hours.

cards.title: Bobst Library Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Bobst Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from collaboration, and use the fifth-floor Research Commons as a focused base for shared study or research.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative research and study space inside Bobst.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU states that Bobst’s Research Commons is on the fifth floor and is designed for collaborative study and research.
cards.access_notes: Bobst access is for current NYU students, faculty, and staff; verify library hours before going.

cards.title: Bobst Snack Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bobst Library, Lower Level 1
cards.notes: When you need a study break, use the Lower Level 1 lounge; NYU lists vending machines and microwaves there for library users.
cards.short_summary: The designated Bobst break space with vending machines and microwaves.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU Libraries lists the Bobst Snack Lounge on Lower Level 1 as available to all library users and notes its vending machines and microwaves.
cards.source_title: How to Use Library Spaces | NYU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located inside Bobst; library building access and current hours apply.

cards.title: Kimmel Center for University Life
cards.subtitle: 60 Washington Square South
cards.notes: Use Kimmel as a meeting point between classes, then look for the building’s lounges, study spaces, student-life offices, and practice rooms.
cards.short_summary: A multiuse student-life hub with study and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes Kimmel as housing student-life offices, dining, music practice rooms, study space, and views of Washington Square Park.
cards.source_title: Kimmel Center for University Life | MEET NYU
cards.access_notes: Spaces and services are intended for the NYU community; access can vary by room and event.

cards.title: NYU Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Kimmel Center, second floor
cards.notes: If you commute, stop by between classes to study, eat lunch, relax, or meet friends; the lounge also offers commuter-focused resources.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Kimmel space dedicated to commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes the Commuter Lounge as a dedicated Kimmel space where commuter students can relax, study, eat lunch, or meet friends.
cards.source_title: Kimmel Center for University Life | MEET NYU
cards.access_notes: Dedicated to commuter students; confirm current eligibility and building access with NYU Student Life.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Kimmel Center for University Life
cards.notes: Try a screen-free pause: secure your phone or laptop in the locked charging stations and use the lounge to connect in person.
cards.short_summary: A device-free Kimmel lounge designed for in-person connection.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes The Nest as a device-free lounge with locked charging stations where students can connect in person.
cards.source_title: The Kimmel Center Is the Heart of Student Life at NYU | MEET NYU
cards.access_notes: Located in Kimmel; check with the building or Student Life for current lounge access.

cards.entity_name: Global Center for Academic and Spiritual Life
cards.title: Global Center for Academic and Spiritual Life
cards.subtitle: Attached to Kimmel Center
cards.notes: Visit for a quiet reset or to find current prayer, meditation, mindfulness, and spiritual-life resources that fit your needs.
cards.short_summary: A campus center connecting students with reflection and spiritual-life resources.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU states that the Global Center for Academic and Spiritual Life provides access to prayer services, meditation spaces, and mindfulness resources.
cards.source_title: The Kimmel Center Is the Heart of Student Life at NYU | MEET NYU
cards.access_notes: Attached to Kimmel; program availability and room access may vary.

cards.entity_name: NYU Skirball Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: NYU Skirball Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: 566 LaGuardia Place
cards.notes: Check the Skirball calendar before heading over, whether you want to attend a performance or simply orient yourself to this Kimmel-adjacent venue.
cards.short_summary: NYU’s large downtown performance venue, sharing a building with Kimmel.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU says the Skirball Center shares Kimmel’s first floor and hosts NYU events as well as external productions.
cards.source_title: Kimmel Center for University Life | MEET NYU
cards.access_notes: Attendance and ticket requirements depend on the individual event; review the event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Paulson Center Commons
cards.subtitle: 181 Mercer Street
cards.notes: Use the Commons as a central stop while exploring Mercer Street, then check the building’s current NYU programming and access guidance.
cards.short_summary: A commons area within NYU’s Paulson Center on Mercer Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU’s Washington Square tour identifies the Paulson Center as home to study spaces and a Commons area, alongside recreation and performing-arts spaces.
cards.access_notes: Inside the Paulson Center; building access and program availability may vary.

cards.title: Washington Square Park
cards.subtitle: At the center of NYU’s Washington Square campus
cards.notes: Meet on the park side of campus, take a break outdoors, and use the surrounding NYU buildings as landmarks for your next stop.
cards.short_summary: The public park around which NYU’s Washington Square campus is organized.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes Washington Square Park as the center of its campus and a common student hangout, surrounded by university buildings.
cards.access_notes: This is a public New York City park; follow posted park rules and any temporary closures.
